##### Project general facts  

New Project by AYS Developers rises as a ten‑storey tower that balances sleek contemporary design with community‑focused planning. The development presents a curated mix of one‑, two-bedroom apartments and studios, each engineered for individuals, professionals and first‑time buyers who value practical layouts and modern finishes. Thoughtful spatial planning ensures that every residence feels both comfortable and convenient, catering to owners and investors alike.  

The development features a refreshing swimming pool and a fully equipped gymnasium for wellness and active living, alongside beautifully landscaped gardens that provide serene spaces for relaxation and reflection. Residents also enjoy on-site restaurants and cafés for convenient dining, a dedicated children's play area for younger residents, and round-the-clock security ensuring complete peace of mind for every member of the community.

Every residence has been thoughtfully designed to maximise comfort and usability, providing a refined sanctuary where residents can truly feel at ease. The building's integrated approach to design ensures that the shared facilities are seamlessly woven into the fabric of daily life, creating a complete and cohesive community where every need is anticipated and every convenience is always close at hand.

##### Location description and benefits  

Dubai Production City offers a tranquil residential ambience while maintaining reasonable access to the city’s principal business districts, making it an appealing choice for those seeking calm without sacrificing connectivity. The neighbourhood’s emerging character is supported by ongoing infrastructure investments that promise enduring value for occupants. Its distinctive blend of peaceful living and proximity to commercial hubs creates a balanced environment for both personal and professional pursuits.  

Efficient travel is facilitated by major road networks that intersect the area, reducing commute times for daily errands and work journeys. Nearby retail outlets, leisure options and bustling business areas place essential conveniences within easy reach. This strategic accessibility reinforces the neighbourhood’s reputation as a sought‑after address for professionals and investors.  

A rich tapestry of experiences unfolds in the surroundings, ranging from diverse retail and dining venues to leisure and business destinations that enrich everyday life. The community’s serene atmosphere pairs harmoniously with well‑planned infrastructure, fostering both personal wellbeing and professional ambition. Consequently, residents enjoy the dual advantage of a quiet residential setting alongside the dynamic energy of a world‑leading city.
